Mod.Author: Kuraudo

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: Added PS1-style options: Optic Blast (vanilla + SAC/UBF), Light up the World (vanilla + SYW), Pixelback, UWback. Added Midgar title screen background, attract mode credit backgrounds and fixed music on title screen. Added alternative world map.

Mod.Name: Nitpick
Mod.Description: This mod gives you access to some niche options and fixes a few minor details. This includes the fixed backgrounds for Seventh Heaven bar sign, Midgar 5 truck label, Sector 5 gate number, Corel Prison sign, black materia shape, Red XIII's portrait etc. It also offers a range of add-ons, including the option to change the background on the title screen and on the credits screen, a disc change screen homage. Listen to music during the title screen and enjoy PSX-style tweaks and more! Additional Authors: Aavock, Cae Lumen, Satsuki, L@zar0, Dangarfield, Kaldarasha, Grimmy, Jusete
